en.headline: EPD says Shek Kwu Chau incinerator fire likely started in construction materials
en.dek: The Environmental Protection Department said preliminary findings point to materials on the roof of the third incineration module, not operations or stored waste, and has suspended intake.
body: The Environmental Protection Department said on Wednesday that a fire at the I·PARK1 waste-to-energy facility off Shek Kwu Chau on Monday was preliminarily suspected to have been sparked by construction materials on the roof of the third incineration module area, where finishing works were under way.

The blaze was not linked to the operation of the incinerator or to stored waste, the department said. It has instructed the contractor to submit an incident report within seven days and is working with police, the Fire Services Department and the Labour Department on the investigation.

I·PARK1 has suspended waste reception since Tuesday. The department has extended operating hours at the West New Territories Landfill Extension to handle waste that would otherwise have gone to the facility, and said the city's overall waste management system continues to operate normally.

The department described online claims of design defects or a collapsing module under construction as groundless. It is assessing damage and will resume reception only after a full check of the structure and critical systems confirms safe operation.

zh.headline: 環保署指石鼓洲焚化爐火警初步涉建築材料起火
zh.dek: 署方表示初步資料顯示起火於第三焚化模組屋頂建築材料，並非運作或儲存廢物引起，設施已暫停接收廢物。
body: 環境保護署周三表示，石鼓洲旁人工島I·PARK1綜合廢物處理設施周一發生的火警，初步懷疑由第三焚化模組範圍屋頂的建築材料引起，該處尚有收尾工程進行。
署方指火警並非由焚化爐運作或儲存的廢物引起。已要求承辦商在事發七天內提交事故報告，並會聯同警方、消防處及勞工處調查原因。
I·PARK1自周二起暫停接收廢物。署方已延長新界西堆填區擴建部分的運作時間，處理原擬運往該設施的廢物，並表示本港整體廢物處理系統運作如常。
署方形容網上指爐組設計缺陷或興建中模組塌下等說法毫無根據。署方正評估損毀情況，在全面檢查結構及主要系統、確認適合安全運作後，才會恢復接收廢物。
